national_news.title: Prataprao Jadhav Reviews Expansion Plans of National Institute of Unani Medicine (NIUM)
bullets: Union Minister of State for Ayush Prataprao Jadhav chaired the 13th Governing Body meeting of NIUM in New Delhi.

The expansion plans include introducing five new postgraduate departments, 35 additional seats, a Department of Integrative and Translational Research, and a second campus in Ghaziabad with a 200-bed referral hospital.
The institute approved allocating 24 seats for foreign students to foster international academic engagement under 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam'.

national_news.title: India and Burkina Faso Explore Cooperation in Traditional Medicine and Medicinal Plant Conservation
bullets: Union Minister for Ayush Prataprao Jadhav held bilateral talks with a delegation from Burkina Faso led by Roger Baro in New Delhi.
Discussions focused on medicinal plant conservation, standardisation of herbal medicines, and promoting Yoga and wellness programmes.
Both nations explored a joint project involving India's National Medicinal Plants Board and institutional partnerships under South-South Cooperation frameworks.

national_news.title: Ministry of Defence Signs Rs 1,976 Crore Deal with Israel Aerospace Industries for Indian Navy's Barak Missile System
bullets: The Ministry of Defence signed a contract worth Rs 1,976.40 crore with Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) in New Delhi.
The project involves major hardware and software upgrades, component replacements, and performance enhancements for the Barak Point Defence Missile System on Indian Navy ships.
The agreement was signed under the Other Capital Procurement Procedure in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh.

national_news.title: EAM Calls for Deeper India-Japan Cooperation at Raisina Tokyo 2026
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar highlighted key areas for India-Japan collaboration, including semiconductors, critical minerals, clean energy, advanced manufacturing, and defence at Raisina Tokyo 2026.
Emphasized shared commitments as Quad, G4, and East Asia Summit partners towards maintaining a free, open, and stable Indo-Pacific region.
Outlined five global landscape features: repeated international shocks, strategic chokepoints, extreme competition, de-risking, and growing reliance on trusted partnerships.

national_news.title: Women's Asian Champions Hockey Tournament Commences in Bhopal
bullets: The Women's Asian Champions Trophy 2026 hockey tournament launched in Bhopal featuring six teams: India, China, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, and Thailand.
India enters the tournament as a three-time winner (2016, 2023, 2024) following its gold medal win at the 2026 Asian Games, which qualified the team for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
The top four teams in the points table after the league stage will qualify for the semi-finals.

national_news.title: Government Targets Addition of 75,000 Medical Seats by 2029
bullets: Union Health and Family Welfare Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda announced a national goal to add 75,000 undergraduate and postgraduate medical seats by 2029.
It was highlighted during the Vardhman Mahavir Medical College convocation that the number of operational AIIMS in India has expanded to 23.
Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan emphasized that initiatives like Ayushman Bharat are key to achieving a 'Swasth Bharat' and building a 'Viksit Bharat'.

national_news.title: PM Modi Visits Philippines for ASEAN-India, East Asia, and Quad Summits
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Manila, Philippines, to participate in the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit, 21st East Asia Summit, and Quad Leaders' Meeting.
Proposed nine initiatives at the ASEAN-India summit, including a long-term maritime plan, free e-visas for ASEAN tourists, cooperation on critical minerals, and a civil nuclear energy framework.
Announced a seafarers' safety initiative at the 21st East Asia Summit to strengthen joint training and emergency response among member nations.

national_news.title: Quad Leaders Announce Maritime, AI, and Infrastructure Initiatives at Manila Summit
bullets: Leaders from India, the US, Australia, and Japan met in Manila to advance cooperation on maritime security, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and supply chain resilience across the Indo-Pacific.
Marked the 10th anniversary of the Free and Open Indo-Pacific vision, reaffirming commitment against unilateral actions altering the regional status quo.
Announced the establishment of the inaugural Quad Business Leaders' Forum, set to launch in early 2027 to boost private-sector and commercial partnerships.

national_news.title: Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya Chairs High-Level Meeting with 13 Sports Universities
bullets: Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports Mansukh Mandaviya chaired a meeting with Vice-Chancellors of 13 Sports Universities in New Delhi to create an integrated national sports ecosystem.
Emphasized inter-university knowledge-sharing, coach exchanges, and developing specific niches of expertise across various sports disciplines.
Urged sports universities to expand focus beyond athlete training into emerging professional fields like Sports Science, Sports Law, Sports Tourism, and sports administration.

national_news.title: Lonar Lake Included in 'Third 100 IUGS Geological Heritage Sites' List
bullets: Lonar Lake in Buldhana district, Maharashtra, has been selected among the 'Third 100 IUGS Geological Heritage Sites' by the International Union of Geological Sciences (IUGS).

Formed approximately 12,000 years ago within the Deccan Traps basaltic lava flows, the 1.88 km wide crater is one of only five known hypervelocity impact structures developed in a basaltic target on Earth.
The nomination proposal was submitted to IUGS through geoheritage conservation initiatives led by the Geological Survey of India (GSI).

bihar_news.title: Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur Bridge Named 'Nitish Setu'
bullets: The newly constructed six-lane Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur Bridge over the Ganga River has been named 'Nitish Setu' after former Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar.

The bridge connects Kachchi Dargah in Patna district with Bidupur in Vaishali district through Raghopur, spanning a main length of approximately 9.76 km and a total length of 19.76 km with approach roads.
The foundation stone was laid in August 2015, and the project is designed to enhance connectivity between North and South Bihar while reducing traffic congestion on the Mahatma Gandhi Setu.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranked 9th in World's Top 10 Museums by Munich Travel Guide
bullets: Patna's Bihar Museum was ranked 9th in Munich-based travel guide 'Worth a Journey' list of the world's 100 best museums for 2026, ahead of the Louvre and the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
It achieved the distinction of being the highest-ranked museum in Asia and the sole Indian entry on the list.
The museum serves as a key asset for heritage diplomacy, highlighted by its 2025 Biennale titled 'Global South: Sharing Histories'.

bihar_news.title: NITI Aayog Launches 'Leadership as Mission' Workshop Series
bullets: NITI Aayog inaugurated a five-part national workshop series titled 'Leadership as Mission' at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, focusing on governance models and major national policy achievements.
NITI Aayog highlighted that achieving the Viksit Bharat 2047 target of a USD 30–40 trillion economy will require a sustained annual real GDP growth rate of 7–10%.
The series covers key developmental pillars including Governance as Delivery, Development as Inclusion, Civilisational Identity, and India’s Global Role.
